segments.contextAfter: [`tolerance`](nsbackgroundactivityscheduler/tolerance.md)—The amount of time before or after the nominal fire date when the activity should be invoked. The nominal fire date is calculated by using the interval combined with the previous fire date or the time when the activity is started.
